## *Dyadic effects*

### Creating dyadic matrices

Defining out-group friendships based on gender and ethnicity

1.  CoDyadCovar = constant dyadic covariate = definiëren wie in- en outgroup van elkaar is
2.  die interacteren met de totWAlt en avSimW

```{r}
library(RSiena)
# GENDER
# matrix was made based on tnss data frame, manually coded as 1 when gender of ego =/= gender of alter. matrix thus represents out-group friendships based on gender
require(readxl)
gender_dyads <- readxl::read_excel("./data/dyads_matrix.xlsx", col_names = F, sheet = 1)
View(gender_dyads)
class(gender_dyads)
gender_dyads <- as.matrix(gender_dyads)

covar_gender_dyads <- as_covariate_rsiena(gender_dyads, centered = FALSE, type = "oneMode")
class(covar_gender_dyads)

# ETHNICITY
# matrix was made based on tnss data frame, manually coded as 1 when ethnicity of ego =/= ethnicity of alter. matrix thus represents out-group friendships
ethnic_dyads <- readxl::read_excel("./data/dyads_matrix.xlsx", col_names = F, sheet = 2)
View(ethnic_dyads)
class(ethnic_dyads)
ethnic_dyads <- as.matrix(ethnic_dyads)

covar_ethnic_dyads <- as_covariate_rsiena(ethnic_dyads, centered = FALSE, type = "oneMode")
class(covar_ethnic_dyads)
```

## *Adding effects*

### First load all the data again

```{r}
library(haven)
tnss_net <- read_sav("./data/TNSS_wave_2010_mentors.sav")
tnss_pup10 <- read_sav("./data/TNSS_wave_2010_pupils.sav")
tnss_pup11 <- read_sav("./data/TNSS_wave_2011_pupils.sav")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
tnss <- left_join(tnss_net, tnss_pup10)
# view(tnss)

tnss_pup10 <- tnss_pup10 %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "id") 

tnss_pup11 <- tnss_pup11 %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "id") 

tnss_2waves <- left_join(tnss_pup10, tnss_pup11, by=c("id"))
# view(tnss_2waves)
tnss_2waves_c5 <- tnss_2waves %>%
  filter(IDClass == 5)
view(tnss_2waves_c5)

c5 <- tnss %>% 
  filter(IDClass == 5)

c5_net <- c5 %>%
  select(fr_1:fr_28)

net <- as.matrix(c5_net)
sum(diag(net) != 0)

view(c5_net)
length(c5_net)

net2 <- net

net2[1,2] <- 1

library(RSiena)
nety <- sienaDependent(array(data = c(net, net2), dim = c(dim(net), 2)), allowOnly = FALSE)

# DV: BEHAVIOR (ETHNIC MINORITY ATTITUDES)

id <- c5 %>% 
  dplyr::select("IDresp")

behy_pre <- tnss_2waves %>% 
  filter(IDresp.x %in% c5$IDresp) %>% 
  dplyr::select("IDresp.x", "thermo_minority", "thermo_minority_2") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  data.frame

id <- left_join(id, behy_pre, by=join_by(IDresp == IDresp.x) )

behy <- id %>% dplyr::select("thermo_minority", "thermo_minority_2") %>% 
  as.matrix()
behy

behy <- sienaDependent(behy, type = c("behavior"))

# gender
class(c5$gender)
gender <- as.numeric(c5$gender)
class(gender)
gender <- as.vector(gender) # 1 = woman
gender_covar <- coCovar(gender) # = constant covariate
class(gender_covar)

# ethnicity
class(c5$ethnicity)
ethnic <- as.vector(ifelse(c5$ethnicity == 1, 0, 1)) # recode so that 1 = migration background, 0 = Dutch
ethnic_covar <- coCovar(ethnic)
class(ethnic_covar)
```

### Define effects structures

```{r}
mydata_0 <- sienaDataCreate(nety, gender_covar, ethnic_covar) # alleen netwerk y
mydata_1 <- sienaDataCreate(nety, gender_covar, ethnic_covar, covar_gender_dyads, covar_ethnic_dyads, behy)

# myeff_simple <- getEffects(mydata_1)
myeff_00 <- getEffects(mydata_1)
myeff_01 <- getEffects(mydata_1)
myeff_02 <- getEffects(mydata_1)
myeff_03 <- getEffects(mydata_1)
myeff_04 <- getEffects(mydata_1)
myeff_2 <- getEffects(mydata_1)
effectsDocumentation(myeff_2)

myeff_001 <- getEffects(mydata_0)
myeff_001a <- getEffects(mydata_0)

# structural network effects (control)
myeff_00 <- includeEffects(myeff_00, density)
myeff_01 <- includeEffects(myeff_00, transTrip)
myeff_02 <- includeEffects(myeff_01, inPop, outAct, outPop)
myeff_001 <- includeEffects(myeff_001, density, transTrip, inPop, outAct, outPop)
myeff_001a <- includeEffects(myeff_001a, density)
myeff_001b <- includeEffects(myeff_001a, transTrip)
myeff_001c <- includeEffects(myeff_001b, inPop, outAct)

# same gender / ethnicity effecten (netwerk)
myeff_03 <- includeEffects(myeff_02, egoX, altX, sameX, interaction1 = "gender_covar")
# myeff_2 <- includeEffects(myeff_2, egoX, altX, sameX, interaction1 = "ethnic_covar")

# gender effect (behavior)
myeff_04 <- set_effect(myeff_02, depvar = "behy", c(effFrom, avXAlt), covar1 ="gender_covar")
# myeff_2 <- includeEffects(myeff_2, effFrom, avXAlt, interaction1="ethnic_covar")

# outgroup friendship effects (dyadic) (behavior)
# influence of primary outgroup friendships on secondary outgroup attitudes
myeff_2 <- set_effect(myeff_02, depvar = "behy", c(totWAlt, avSimW), covar1 = "nety", covar2 = "covar_gender_dyads")

# myeff_2 <- set_effect(myeff_2, depvar = "behy", c(totWAlt, avSimW), covar1 = "nety", covar2 = "covar_ethnic_dyads")

# waarom werkt dit niet?
# myeff_2 <- includeInteraction(myeff_2, egoX, X, totWAlt, interaction1 = c("covar_gender_dyads", ""))

# Adding influence effects for indegree, outdegree and assimilation
myeff_2 <- includeEffects(myeff_2, name = "behy", avAlt, indeg, outdeg, interaction1 = "nety")

# effecten van netwerk op secondary outgroup attitudes
myeff_2 <- includeEffects(myeff_2, egoX, altX, absDiffX, interaction1 = "behy")

```

## *Goodness of fit*

```{r}

# The geodesic distribution is not available from within RSiena, and therefore is copied from the help page of sienaGOF-auxiliary:

GeodesicDistribution <- function(i, data, sims, period, groupName, varName, levls = c(1:5, Inf), cumulative = TRUE,
    ...) {
    x <- networkExtraction(i, data, sims, period, groupName, varName)
    require(sna)
    a <- sna::geodist(symmetrize(x))$gdist
    if (cumulative) {
        gdi <- sapply(levls, function(i) {
            sum(a <= i)
        })
    } else {
        gdi <- sapply(levls, function(i) {
            sum(a == i)
        })
    }
    names(gdi) <- as.character(levls)
    gdi
}
```
